item.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' launch roster size revealed
item.description: <p>It's been more than eight months since <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/jun/04/marvel-tokon-fighting-arcsys/">Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls was first revealed</a>, but there <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/04/240-days-marvel-tokon/">haven't been any more character reveals since then</a>.</p> <p>While we haven't gotten to see any new fighters yet, it appears we now know how many in total are going to be in Marvel Tokon at launch.</p>

item.title: Nearly half of 2XKO's developers laid off as Riot Games says momentum not enough to sustain team, FGC members impacted
item.description: <p>It hasn't even been a month <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/19/season-1-patch-notes-2xko/">since 2XKO finally launched in full</a>, but the game is apparently already facing some setbacks and restructuring.</p> <p>Riot Games made the unfortunate announcement today that they are downsizing <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/2xko/">2XKO</a>'s development team moving forward by quite a large margin.</p>

item.title: Capcom reveals the 28 winning pieces of the third Street Fighter 6 New Challenger Art Contest
item.description: <p>Over the few years that <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/'>Street Fighter 6</a> has been available, Capcom has been hosting art contests. They've just announced the results of the third Street Fighter 6 New Challenger Art Contest.</p> <p>Through this competition, aspiring artists are able to get their creations featured into Street Fighter 6 itself in the form of "Here Comes a New Challenger" splash screens. As such, 28 new winners will have their work featured.</p>

item.title: Character breakdowns for Anissa and Lucan in Invincible Vs
item.description: <p>It's only been a little while since <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/26/anissa-lucan-invincible-vs-gameplay/'>Anissa and Lucan</a> were announced as the latest playable characters in <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/invincible-vs/'>Invincible Vs</a>. Their combined gameplay trailer gave us quite a bit of insight on how they'll play in-game.</p> <p>Lucan is clearly intended to be a grappler within Invincible Vs. Meanwhile, Anissa emphasizes rush down gameplay.</p>
